title: Change the details of a food safety registered training organisation
summary: This page explains how a registered training organisation (RTO) under the food safety supervisor program can notify the NSW Food Authority of changes to its details.
intro: If you're a registered training organisation (RTO) under the food safety supervisor program and your details have changed, you need to notify the NSW Food Authority.
who_can_apply: You are a registered training organisation (RTO) under the food safety supervisor program and your details have changed.
what_you_need: Your NSW Food Authority RTO number
Changes to your scope of registration (if applicable)
The certificate of registration of your business name (if applicable)
The PDF form – 'Registered Training Organisation change of details form'

how_to_steps.text: Submit your application by mail or email, to the details on the form.
